title: Quantum simulation of the Dicke model in a two-dimensional ion crystal
summary: Quantum many-body systems driven far from equilibrium can exhibit phase transitions, chaos and entanglement, but probing these phenomena in large, nearly closed systems remains challenging. The Dicke model, which couples an ensemble of two-level systems collectively to a single bosonic mode, provides a fundamental framework for exploring these phenomena in light-matter interactions.
